borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Separator (`#DBDBDB` light / `#262626` dark): Hairline dividers between feed posts, between navigation and content, between stacked list rows.

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: The single chromatic exception is the Instagram logomark gradient — that famous purple-to-pink-to-orange-to-yellow sweep (`#833AB4` → `#FD1D1D` → `#FCAF45`) — which appears in exactly three places: the app icon, the Stories ring for unread stories, and the Reels/Create action. Nowhere else. No buttons, no accents, no badges. This scarcity is what makes the gradient iconic. Everything else defaults to black (`#000000`) or white (`#FFFFFF`), with grays between them for secondary affordances.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心
panels.body: 适合在 390×844 画布中预览的移动产品体验。

panels.title: 颜色与字体可复用
panels.body: 页面从本地 metadata 与 Design.md 提取 palette、typography 和标签，用于快速预览主题质感。

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Keep all chrome monochrome — black, white, gray only。
建议：Reserve the Instagram gradient for Stories rings, the Create action, and brand moments。
建议：Use SF Pro — never introduce a custom body typeface。
建议：Bleed media edge-to-edge with zero corner radius on photos and videos。
建议：Use outlined icons by default, filled icons for active/selected state。
dont: 避免：introduce new accent colors beyond the defined palette — the monochrome chrome is the brand。
避免：apply the brand gradient to buttons, text, or general UI — it's reserved。
避免：round feed photo corners — edge-to-edge squares and portraits are sacred。
避免：add text labels to the tab bar — the icons do the work。
避免：use large-title nav bars — Instagram is compact-title throughout。
